description: Paired comparison of Bgee expression scores for abhd-11.2 and abhd-11.1 across matched C. elegans anatomical entities
code:
import requests, json, pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
s=requests.Session(); s.headers.update({"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0","Accept":"application/json"})
def bgee(g, limit=100):
    u=(f"https://api.bgee.org/api/?page=data&action=expr_calls&get_results=1&data_type=all"
       f"&gene_id={g}&species_id=6239&cond_param=anat_entity&display_type=json&limit={limit}")
    j=s.get(u,timeout=60).json()
    calls=j.get("data",{}).get("expressionData",{}).get("expressionCalls",[])
    rows=[]
    for c in calls:
        ae=c.get("condition",{}).get("anatEntity",{})
        sc=c.get("expressionScore",{})
        rows.append(dict(anat_id=ae.get("id"), anat=ae.get("name"),
                         score=float(sc.get("expressionScore")) if sc.get("expressionScore") not in (None,"NA") else np.nan,
                         conf=sc.get("expressionScoreConfidence")))
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)
a2=bgee("WBGene00011029"); a1=bgee("WBGene00009316")
print("n calls:", len(a2), len(a1))
m=a2.merge(a1, on=["anat_id","anat"], suffixes=("_abhd11_2","_abhd11_1")).dropna(subset=["score_abhd11_2","score_abhd11_1"])
m=m.drop_duplicates("anat_id")
m["ratio"]=m.score_abhd11_2/m.score_abhd11_1
m=m.sort_values("score_abhd11_2",ascending=False)
pd.set_option("display.width",230); pd.set_option("display.max_colwidth",45)
print(m[["anat_id","anat","score_abhd11_2","score_abhd11_1","ratio"]].to_string(index=False))
m.to_csv("bgee_expression.csv",index=False)
t=stats.ttest_rel(m.score_abhd11_2,m.score_abhd11_1); w=stats.wilcoxon(m.score_abhd11_2,m.score_abhd11_1)
dz=(m.score_abhd11_2-m.score_abhd11_1).mean()/(m.score_abhd11_2-m.score_abhd11_1).std(ddof=1)
print(f"\nmatched anatomical entities n={len(m)}; mean score abhd-11.2 {m.score_abhd11_2.mean():.1f} vs abhd-11.1 {m.score_abhd11_1.mean():.1f}")
print(f"paired t={t.statistic:.2f} p={t.pvalue:.2e}; Wilcoxon p={w.pvalue:.2e}; Cohen dz={dz:.2f}; median ratio {m.ratio.median():.1f}x")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,5.2))
ax=axes[0]
for _,r in m.iterrows(): ax.plot([0,1],[r.score_abhd11_2,r.score_abhd11_1],"-o",color="#777",ms=4,alpha=.7)
ax.set_xticks([0,1]); ax.set_xticklabels(["abhd-11.2\n(SF4)","abhd-11.1\n(SF3)"])
ax.set_ylabel("Bgee expression score"); ax.set_ylim(0,100)
ax.set_title(f"a  Matched-tissue expression, C. elegans (n={len(m)} anatomical entities)\n"
             f"paired t p = {t.pvalue:.1e}, median ratio {m.ratio.median():.1f}x",fontsize=10,loc="left")
ax=axes[1]
top=m.head(14).iloc[::-1]
y=np.arange(len(top))
ax.barh(y-0.2,top.score_abhd11_2,0.38,label="abhd-11.2",color="#4C72B0")
ax.barh(y+0.2,top.score_abhd11_1,0.38,label="abhd-11.1",color="#C44E52")
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels([a[:34] for a in top.anat],fontsize=7.5)
ax.set_xlabel("Bgee expression score"); ax.legend(fontsize=8,frameon=False)
ax.set_title("b  Per-tissue expression scores",fontsize=10,loc="left")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
